question: A thin, non-conducting rod of length $L$ lies on the x-axis from $x=0$ to $x=L$. It carries a total charge $+Q$ distributed uniformly. A negative point charge $-Q$ is fixed on the x-axis at $x = -L$. Analyze the forces between the point charge and the rod by integrating the contributions from each element of the rod. What is the magnitude of the net electrostatic force on the rod?
